title: Israeli Salad
description: Finely diced tomato, cucumber and peppers with herbs and lemon.

ingredients.item: fresh herbs: parsley, mint, cilantro or a mix
lemon, zested, then juiced to taste (start with half)

steps.do: Cut the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and both peppers into a very small, even dice, and chop the herbs. The finer the cut, the better the salad, so take your time and use your sharpest knife.
Toss everything in a large bowl with the zest, olive oil, half the lemon's juice, salt and pepper.
Taste and adjust. If it seems flat, it usually wants more salt, then more lemon.

notes: Watery salad: salt the diced cucumber and tomato and drain in a colander for 30 minutes before mixing.
Keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge, best in the first two. Ripe summer tomatoes make the biggest difference.
Variations: dill works in place of the other herbs. A can of chickpeas, or some cooked quinoa, turns it into a main.
Serve over a smear of hummus, in warm pita, or alongside Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma with either tahini sauce.
nutrition: Per 1 cup: 83 cal · 1.4 g protein · 7.1 g carbs · 1.6 g fiber · 4 g sugar · 5.8 g fat · 0.9 g sat fat · 11.4 mg sodium
